BiblicalUsage: Pagiel, son of Ocran, is the prince and chief of the tribe of Asher at the time of the exodus. He is counted in the census in the wilderness of Sinai and brings Asher's offering on the eleventh day of the dedication of the altar.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Pagiel's name, event of God, fits his place: every tribe has a chief, and every chief stands in the census God ordered.
